import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract IDs and prepare features
train_ids = train_df["Id"].values
test_ids = test_df["Id"].values

X = train_df.drop(columns=["Id", "Cover_Type"])
y = train_df["Cover_Type"].astype(int) - 1  # 0-indexed for LightGBM

X_test = test_df.drop(columns=["Id"])


# Feature engineering (same as before)
def add_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df["Hydrology_Distance"] = np.sqrt(
        df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"] ** 2
        + df["Vertical_Distance_To_Hydrology"] ** 2
    )
    df["Fire_Distance"] = df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"]
    df["Road_Distance"] = df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"]
    df["Hillshade_Mean"] = df[
        ["Hillshade_9am", "Hillshade_Noon", "Hillshade_3pm"]
    ].mean(axis=1)
    df["Hillshade_Var"] = df[["Hillshade_9am", "Hillshade_Noon", "Hillshade_3pm"]].var(
        axis=1
    )
    df["Elevation_Slope"] = df["Elevation"] * df["Slope"]
    wilderness_cols = [c for c in df.columns if "Wilderness_Area" in c]
    df["Wilderness_Sum"] = df[wilderness_cols].sum(axis=1)
    return df


X = add_features(X)
X_test = add_features(X_test)

# Stratified K-fold parameters
n_splits = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# LightGBM params (same as previous best)
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": 7,
    "metric": "multi_error",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 128,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# OOF predictions for validation
oof_preds = np.zeros((X.shape[0], 7))
test_preds = np.zeros((X_test.shape[0], 7))

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    print(f"Fold {fold+1}/{n_splits}", end=" ")

    X_train_fold = X.iloc[train_idx]
    y_train_fold = y.iloc[train_idx]
    X_val_fold = X.iloc[val_idx]
    y_val_fold = y.iloc[val_idx]

    # Prepare datasets
    train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_fold, label=y_train_fold)
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val_fold, label=y_val_fold, reference=train_data)

    # Train with early stopping
    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_data,
        valid_sets=[val_data],
        num_boost_round=1000,
        callbacks=[
            lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
            lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
        ],
    )

    # Store OOF predictions
    oof_preds[val_idx] = model.predict(X_val_fold, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

    # Accumulate test predictions
    test_preds += model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration) / n_splits

# Compute OOF validation accuracy
oof_classes = np.argmax(oof_preds, axis=1)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y, oof_classes)
print(f"\nValidation accuracy (OOF): {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Convert test predictions back to 1-indexed classes
test_pred_classes = np.argmax(test_preds, axis=1) + 1

# Submit
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": test_pred_classes})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved!")
